calibur.note: Calibur v1.1.0, the EIP-7702 delegate (commit d7dbc80); immutable; fetched from Base at block 52126500, as teeswap's fixtures; keccak ba697585ba58ba66ebd095ab4c7f980ed42ad115b2e3bb9b5b9bdf167bf08b1b on all six mainnets

permit2.note: Permit2; its EIP-712 domain rebuilds for the local chain id; fetched from Base (eip155:8453) at block 51690813, as teeswap's fixtures

x402_exact_permit2_proxy.note: x402's exact-scheme Permit2 proxy; Permit2's address is an immutable; fetched from Base (eip155:8453) at block 51690813, as teeswap's fixtures

usdc_fiat_token_v2_2.note: USDC's FiatTokenV2_2 implementation, installed directly at Ethereum's USDC address (no proxy) and initialised by localchain; fetched from Base's implementation, 0x2Ce6311ddAE708829bc0784C967b7d77D19FD779, at block 51690813, as teeswap's fixtures; balance_slot (balanceAndBlacklistStates) and allowance_slot (allowed) found by writing them and reading balanceOf and allowance on anvil

usdc_signature_checker.note: library linked into usdc_fiat_token_v2_2, at the address its code names; fetched from Base (eip155:8453) at block 51690813, as teeswap's fixtures

weth9.note: Ethereum's WETH9 at its address there; fetched from Ethereum at block 26202213, as teeswap's fixtures; storage: its name, symbol and decimals (slots 0 to 2)

usdt.note: Tether's TetherToken: transfer and transferFrom return no bool; fetched from Ethereum at block 26218303; storage: its name, symbol and decimals (slots 7 to 9), as there; balance_slot: its balances mapping, found where keccak(holder, slot) holds balanceOf(holder) there

uni.note: Uniswap's UNI: EIP-2612 permit (its domain built from the chain id at call time), no EIP-3009; name and symbol are constants in its code; fetched from Ethereum at block 26218303; balance_slot: its balances mapping (uint96 values), found as usdt's

uniswap_v2_usdc_weth.note: Uniswap v2's USDC/WETH pair; fetched from Ethereum at block 26225823; storage: its factory (slot 5), token0 (USDC) and token1 (WETH) (slots 6 and 7), as there, and unlocked (slot 12) 1, as its constructor sets; its liquidity minted by localchain

uniswap_v3_usdc_weth.note: Uniswap v3's USDC/WETH 0.05% pool; token0 (USDC) and token1 (WETH) are immutables in its code; fetched from Ethereum at block 26225823; initialised and its liquidity minted by localchain

uniswap_v3_weth_usdt.note: Uniswap v3's WETH/USDT 0.3% pool; token0 (WETH) and token1 (USDT) are immutables in its code; fetched from Ethereum at block 26225823; initialised and its liquidity minted by localchain

uniswap_v3_usdc_usdt.note: Uniswap v3's USDC/USDT 0.01% pool; token0 (USDC) and token1 (USDT) are immutables in its code; fetched from Ethereum at block 26234897; initialised and its liquidity minted by localchain

uniswap_v2_factory.note: Uniswap v2's factory: a pair asks it for feeTo when liquidity is minted (none: no storage, fees off); fetched from Ethereum at block 26234897

uniswap_v3_position_manager.note: Uniswap v3's NonfungiblePositionManager, which localchain mints the pools' liquidity through; its factory and WETH9 are immutables in its code; fetched from Ethereum at block 26234897; storage: its name and symbol (slots 6 and 7), as there, and _nextId and _nextPoolId (slot 13) 1, as its constructor sets

uniswap_swap_router02.note: Uniswap's SwapRouter02, which the treasury swaps through; its v2 and v3 factories, position manager and WETH9 are immutables in its code, so it finds the pools above at their Ethereum addresses; fetched from Ethereum at block 26234897

coinbase_smart_wallet.note: Coinbase Smart Wallet's implementation (the factory's implementation()), an ERC-1271 contract payer: its accounts are ERC-1967 proxies the factory creates; fetched from Ethereum

coinbase_smart_wallet_factory.note: Coinbase Smart Wallet's factory: createAccount(owners, nonce), at the same address on Ethereum, Base and Sepolia; an ERC-6492 signature names it to deploy an account; fetched from Ethereum

coinbase_smart_wallet_1_1.note: Coinbase Smart Wallet v1.1's implementation (coinbase/smart-wallet v1.1.0, the factory's implementation()): what CDP's and the Base Account SDK's new accounts are, ERC-1967 proxies the factory creates; fetched from Ethereum

coinbase_smart_wallet_factory_1_1.note: Coinbase Smart Wallet v1.1's factory: createAccount(owners, nonce) as v1's, at the same address on Ethereum, Base and Sepolia; fetched from Ethereum

entry_point_0_7.note: ERC-4337's EntryPoint v0.7, at its address on every chain: viem finds a smart account's address through its getSenderAddress; its SenderCreator is entry_point_0_7_sender_creator; fetched from Ethereum at block 26291841

entry_point_0_7_sender_creator.note: EntryPoint v0.7's SenderCreator, which it created first (its immutable): calls the factory for getSenderAddress; fetched from Ethereum at block 26291841

entry_point_0_8.note: ERC-4337's EntryPoint v0.8, at its address on every chain: EIP-712 op hashes and EIP-7702 accounts; its SenderCreator is entry_point_0_8_sender_creator; fetched from Ethereum at block 26296722

entry_point_0_8_sender_creator.note: EntryPoint v0.8's SenderCreator, which it created first (its immutable, senderCreator()): calls a factory, or an EIP-7702 account's initialisation; fetched from Ethereum at block 26296722

simple_7702_account.note: eth-infinitism's Simple7702Account for EntryPoint v0.8, the delegate viem's toSimple7702SmartAccount names: an EOA delegating to it is an ERC-4337 account; fetched from Ethereum at block 26296722

kernel_meta_factory.note: ZeroDev's FactoryStaker, the factory a Kernel v3 account names (getFactoryArgs): deployWithFactory(factory, initData, salt) calls a factory it has approved; fetched from Ethereum at block 26291841; storage: approved[kernel_factory_3_2] (the mapping at slot 0), as on Ethereum

kernel_factory_3_2.note: Kernel v3.2's factory (@zerodev/sdk KERNEL_V3_2): createAccount(initData, salt) clones kernel_3_2 and initialises it; fetched from Ethereum at block 26291841

kernel_3_2.note: Kernel v3.2's implementation (an ERC-7579 account; EntryPoint v0.7 its immutable), what AgentKit's ZeroDevWalletProvider makes; fetched from Ethereum at block 26291841

kernel_ecdsa_validator.note: ZeroDev's ECDSA validator for Kernel v3.1 and later, a key owning the account as its root (sudo) validator; fetched from Ethereum at block 26291841

zerodev_intent_executor_0_0_3.note: ZeroDev's intent executor (@zerodev/intent INTENT_V0_3), an executor module AgentKit's ZeroDevWalletProvider installs as the account is created (initConfig); fetched from Ethereum at block 26291841

calibur.note: Calibur's deployment: calldata `salt ‖ initcode` to Arachnid's deployer (script/DeployCaliburEntry.s.sol), from Ethereum's transaction 0xfefdb33b42cd39941995a607241cf3f63933c3daadd6a4298ef0a9ccead5751e at block 25439823; replayed on a chain without it, it puts Calibur at the same address

x402_exact_permit2_proxy.note: x402's exact-scheme Permit2 proxy's deployment: calldata `salt ‖ initcode` to Arachnid's deployer, the salt EXACT_SALT and the initcode script/data/exact-proxy-initcode.hex of coinbase/x402's contracts/evm/script/Deploy.s.sol (commit 0e6e8c5; initcode keccak e774d1d5a07218946ab54efe010b300481478b86861bb17d69c98a57f68a604c, Permit2's address in its constructor argument); replayed on a chain without it, it puts the proxy at the same address
